name: Custom & Non-Dexed Pokémon Pack (18 Fighters)
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: 18 playable Non-Dexed, Glitch, Beta, Spin-Off, and Mega/Primal Pokémon including MissingNo., Shadow Lugia, Primal Dialga, Bad Egg, Substitute Doll, Beta Arceus, and more.
description: Expands the core Custom region (#2000-#9999) with 18 fully animated playable fighters: 13 iconic Non-Dexed, Glitch, Beta, and Spin-Off legends (MissingNo. with animated Gen 1 glitch sprites and DMG-Green Shiny, Substitute Doll, Bad Egg, Shadow Lugia XD001, Primal Dialga, Shadow Mewtwo, Eternal Flower Floette, Ultra Necrozma, Beta Arceus, Purple Kecleon, Mikon Beta Vulpix, Pikachu Libre, and Hakogame Beta Turtle) plus 5 Special Forms (Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, and Ash-Greninja). Every fighter includes 8-direction animations, portraits, signature custom attacks with Core Custom VFX, and custom Ultimates.
highlights: Glitch & Oddity icons: MissingNo. (#2011, with custom animated glitch sheet & DMG-Green Shiny), Substitute Doll (#2012), and Bad Egg (#2013)

Spin-Off & Unreleased legends: Shadow Lugia XD001 (#2014), Primal Dialga (#2015), Shadow Mewtwo (#2016), Eternal Flower Floette (#2017), Ultra Necrozma (#2018), Beta Arceus (#2019), Purple Kecleon (#2020), Mikon (#2021), Pikachu Libre (#2022), and Hakogame (#2023)
Special Forms: Mega Rayquaza, Primal Groudon, Primal Kyogre, Mega Mewtwo X, and Ash-Greninja
37 signature custom attacks, 15 custom GPU VFX presets, 18 custom Ultimates, and 5 custom Pokéball pickup items
Drop-in ./characters/ folder support — runs natively via the Core Modding API (no separate enabler mod required)
